purpose: Render │-separated outgoing message contents and the model's verbatim /api/show chat-template string in the request-preview panel (AC-UX-5), and reconcile the computed content-token count against a completed turn's reported prompt_eval_count as three labelled figures — never presented as a mismatch/error/warning — with tool-call turns reporting reconciliation-unavailable and a named reason (AC-UX-6, AC-TOK-5). All filtering/tokenization/reconciliation arithmetic lives in src/lib/token-view.ts (an extension of S2/S3's module, per AC-STRUCT-3 and this story's own notes); chat-workspace.tsx and the new src/components/request-preview-extras.tsx are wiring/presentation only.

public_api.name: toOllamaFilteredMessages
public_api.description: Hand-kept mirror of server/ollama-client.ts's private toOllamaMessages (~245-301), translated to this side of the server/src boundary (Boundary Rule 1 forbids importing it directly). Reproduces its exact filtering rules (meta skip, empty-system drop, pending-tool-call flush ahead of user/assistant/tool_result, trailing flush). The sole legal source of the outgoing-message list for AC-UX-5 rendering and AC-UX-6/AC-TOK-5 reconciliation — never requestJsonPreview (buildOpenAIRequestBody/toOpenAIMessages), per Implementation Constraint 5.

public_api.name: findLastUsageStep
public_api.signature: findLastUsageStep(steps: ConversationStep[]): { index: number; promptEvalCount: number } | null
public_api.description: Locates the reconciliation oracle: the last assistant step reporting usage.inputTokens. null when nothing has completed yet.

public_api.name: turnHasToolCall
public_api.description: True when the turn producing steps[assistantIndex] (walking back to the nearest preceding user step) contains a tool_call step. Scoped to the turn, not the whole conversation, so an earlier turn's tool use doesn't invalidate a later, tool-free turn's reconciliation.

public_api.name: TEMPLATE_OVERHEAD_LABEL
public_api.description: AC-UX-6's exact, non-alarming label for the computed/reported difference — "chat-template overhead", never "mismatch"/"error"/"warning".

public_api.name: RECONCILIATION_TOOL_CALL_REASON
public_api.description: Named reason surfaced when a tool-call turn makes reconciliation unavailable (AC-UX-6, Implementation Constraint 4).

public_api.name: useTokenizedMessages
public_api.signature: useTokenizedMessages(messages: OllamaMessage[], tokenizeText: ((text: string) => Promise<string[]>) | undefined, active: boolean, cacheKeySuffix?: string): Array<OllamaMessage & { tokens: string[] | null }>
public_api.description: Batch-tokenizes a fixed message list while `active`, caching by (message contents, cacheKeySuffix). cacheKeySuffix carries the model, mirroring S3's invariant-computed-boundary-model-key discipline so a model switch invalidates stale tokens instead of serving them under a mismatched key.

public_api.name: useReconciliation
public_api.signature: useReconciliation(steps: ConversationStep[], tokenizeText: ((text: string) => Promise<string[]>) | undefined, active: boolean, cacheKeySuffix?: string): ReconciliationState
public_api.description: AC-UX-6/AC-TOK-5's readout: status 'none' (nothing completed yet) | 'unavailable' (tool-call turn, with reason) | 'pending' (tokenize round trip in flight) | 'ready' (contentTokenCount, promptEvalCount, overhead).
